children: Ellington Financial plans a $100 million offering of 7.375% senior unsecured notes due 2030, guaranteed by the company.
Announced offering of $100 million aggregate principal of 7.375% senior unsecured notes due 2030 as additional notes.
New Notes will be treated as a single class with existing $400 million 7.375% notes under the October 6, 2025 indenture.
Notes are senior unsecured obligations of issuers and fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Ellington Financial.
Net proceeds expected for general corporate purposes, including repaying repurchase agreement borrowings and funding asset purchases.
Offering limited to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and non-U.S. persons outside the U.S. under Regulation S; not registered under the Securities Act.
